editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ServiceNow Discovery Implementation Prep exam by reviewing the four domains, exam structure, and recommended study strategies.
editorial.overview: The ServiceNow Discovery Implementation Prep exam is designed to validate your professional expertise in implementing ServiceNow Discovery features within complex enterprise environments. Administered by ServiceNow, this 90-minute assessment consists of 60 questions that evaluate your technical proficiency in discovery patterns, system configuration, the Configuration Management Database, and overall engagement readiness for successful project deployments.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification exam is specifically intended for system implementers, technical administrators, and professional consultants who are responsible for configuring, managing, and maintaining ServiceNow Discovery implementations within diverse enterprise IT environments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: To prepare effectively, candidates should review the official ServiceNow exam guides and documentation. You should practice setting up discovery configurations, managing the CMDB, designing complex patterns, and preparing for discovery engagements using the provided materials. Engaging with hands-on labs and reviewing technical implementation scenarios will help reinforce your understanding of the core concepts required for this certification.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers Discovery Pattern Design, which accounts for 35.0 percent of the exam content. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in pattern design principles and the technical customization of various discovery patterns.

This section focuses on Discovery Configuration, representing 35.0 percent of the total exam weight. You will be tested on your ability to manage configuration settings and perform necessary discovery source setup tasks.

This domain addresses the Configuration Management Database, which carries a 15.0 percent weight on the exam. Focus your studies on understanding CMDB integration processes and the technical requirements for accurate CI relationship mapping.

This domain focuses on Discovery Engagement Readiness, contributing 15.0 percent to the final evaluation. Candidates are expected to understand the practical aspects of engagement planning and the validation of readiness for discovery projects.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time effectively across the 60 questions during the 90 minutes allotted for the exam. Read each item carefully and check with ServiceNow for the current certification path details before your scheduled appointment.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 60 questions in total. These questions are distributed across four distinct domains to ensure a thorough assessment of your implementation skills and technical knowledge.
The passing score for this certification exam is determined on a Pass/Fail basis. You must demonstrate sufficient competency across all tested domains to achieve a passing result on the assessment.
You are given 90 minutes to complete the entire assessment. It is important to manage your time wisely during the session to ensure you have enough time to answer every question.

This certification is officially administered by ServiceNow. It is designed specifically for implementation professionals who need to validate their expertise in managing and configuring ServiceNow Discovery tools in enterprise settings.
